laws.rule: Slovenský raj National Park gorges (ladders and footbridges): 'Suchá Belá+' ticket €4 (about A$6.36 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026) ages 15 to 65, €3 (about A$4.77 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026) over 65 and 6 to 15; 'other gorges' ticket €3 (about A$4.77 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026) and €2 (about A$3.18 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026); under 6 free. Write the date on the ticket or it is invalid.
laws.heading: Slovenský raj

laws.rule: Slovenský raj National Park: gorges may be walked one way only, upstream. Dogs on a lead and muzzled (they cannot climb the ladders). Tents and bivouacs only in campsites; fires only at designated sites.
